data_description.url: Address of the ADBTuner web interface, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5592
data_description.guide_url: Optional. An XMLTV guide whose channel ids match your ADBTuner channels' M3U ids (for example a FruitDeepLinks or ESPN4CC4C guide). Enables 'Now playing' sensors and a guide calendar.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an ADBTuner server at that address.

abort.already_configured: This ADBTuner server is already set up.

data_description.guide_url: Leave empty to turn off the guide calendar and 'Now playing' sensors.

tune.name: Tune channel
tune.description: Tune a tuner to a channel and keep it there (Home Assistant holds the stream open), e.g. to watch the encoder directly.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel number (e.g. 2306), M3U id (e.g. peacock_web06) or exact channel name.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Release the tuner after this long. Default 4 hours.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Release a tuner that Home Assistant is holding.
